Print Method for Multinomial GLMMs

Source: R/source_mnGLMM.R
print.mnGLMM.Rd

Prints a fitted multinomial GLMM, using the same layout as summary.mnGLMM.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mnGLMM'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

An object of class "mnGLMM", as returned by the mnGLMM function.

...

Additional arguments passed to summary.mnGLMM.

Value

x, invisibly.

Examples

data(story_pollen_matrix)
sample_idx <- which(rowSums(story_pollen_matrix) != 0)
n <- ncol(story_pollen_matrix)
glmm_mod <- mnGLMM(Y = story_pollen_matrix[sample_idx, ], V.fixed = diag(n))
print(glmm_mod)
